lines.text: Meet WaFine: WhatsApp, with an AI teammate.
First, request an invite with your email and number.
Then scan the QR in WaFine with WhatsApp, under Linked devices.
Create an API key. It shows once, so save it.
Send your first message with one request. Try messaging yourself.
Auto-replies take their time, so your number stays human.
Finally, add WaFine to Claude as a custom connector.
That's it. See you on the waitlist.
